record.paper_title: Some open problems on Banach spaces
record.original_question: Does every Banach lattice X have an injective envelope, meaning a pair (E, iota) in which E is an injective Banach lattice, iota maps X into E as a lattice isometry, and no proper injective sublattice of E contains iota(X)? Here injective means 1-injective: positive operators from closed sublattices into E extend positively to the whole Banach lattice with no increase in norm.

evidence.quote: An injective envelope of a Banach lattice X is a pair ( X, ι) with X an injective Banach lattice and ι: X → X a lattice isometry such that the only sublattice of X that is injective and contains ι(X) is X itself, cf. [5].
Problem 4.5. Does every Banach lattice have an injective envelope?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Call a Banach lattice E injective (more precisely, 1-injective) if for every Banach lattice Y, every closed sublattice F ⊆ Y, and every positive linear operator T: F → E, there exists a positive linear extension T̃: Y → E with ‖T̃‖ = ‖T‖.

Given a Banach lattice X, an injective envelope of X is a pair (E, ι) such that:
(i) E is an injective Banach lattice,
(ii) ι: X → E is a lattice isometry, and
(iii) E itself is the only closed sublattice of E which is injective and contains ι(X) (minimality).

Question: Does every Banach lattice X admit an injective envelope in this sense?
artifact.status_search_result: While injective envelopes are well established for Banach spaces (Cohen), C*-algebras (Hamana), operator spaces and operator systems, no source found explicitly confirms or refutes the existence of injective envelopes for arbitrary Banach lattices in the 1-injective sense. Recent works on injective Banach lattices (e.g., on injectivity of ℓ^p in p-convex lattices, 2024) address related questions but do not resolve the general envelope problem.

status_evidence.title: Banach lattices with upper p-estimates: free and injective objects
status_evidence.snippet: Proves injectivity of ℓ^p in the class of p-convex Banach lattices and non-injectivity of ℓ^{p,∞} in upper-p-estimate class; does not settle existence of injective envelopes in the category of all Banach lattices.
status_evidence.claim: Recent results address related injectivity questions in subclasses, but not the general envelope existence.

status_evidence.title: A very short proof of the existence of the injective envelope of operator systems
status_evidence.snippet: Discusses existence of injective envelopes for operator systems and analogous categories.
status_evidence.claim: Injective envelopes are known to exist in several adjacent categories (Banach spaces, operator systems, C*-algebras), but no analogous general theorem for Banach lattices is cited.
